neighbours.label: split-off word-opening piece ' o' / ' bo' / ' о' (boar, ocelot, oboe, олень): the first piece of a word broken after its opening syllable
fire: Villagers feared the huge boar that trampled their potato fields.
The vet specialises in bovine diseases on dairy farms.
His boorish remarks embarrassed everyone at the wedding.
Deep in the rainforest an ocelot stalked a sleeping bird.
She played a mournful oboe solo in the second movement.
Don't be such an oaf, you nearly knocked over the vase.
Утром на поляну вышел большой олень с рогами.
Фермер вывел каждую овцу на зелёный луг.
quiet: Villagers feared the huge bear that trampled their potato fields.
The vet specialises in equine diseases on dairy farms.
His rude remarks embarrassed everyone at the wedding.
Deep in the rainforest a jaguar stalked a sleeping bird.
She played a mournful violin solo in the second movement.
Don't be so clumsy, you nearly knocked over the vase.
Утром на поляну вышел большой лось с рогами.
Фермер вывел каждую корову на зелёный луг.

notes: Card: ' bo' x7, ' o' x5, ' co' x5, ' о' x4 (opossum, boar, bovine, coasts). Probe: оленя 0.774, boar 0.588, ocelot 0.361, oaf 0.346, opossum only 0.090 (peak on 'sum'); raccoon/pig/oven controls 0.002-0.005.
